Quercus incana Roxb.
Medium-sized evergreen tree, 10-20 m tall. Young shoots densely tomentose. 
Leaves coriaceous, elliptic-lanceolate, (6-)8-15 x 2.5-5 cm long, margins sharply serrate in upper half, glabrous above, white-tomentose beneath. 
Petiole 8-15 mm long. Stipules linear, deciduous. 
Acorns solitary or paired, ovoid-globose, 1.5-2.5 cm across.
